supportedClaims: Regime sensitivity protocol was defined before execution.
Frozen regime grid contained 23 points and 69 runs.
Seed stability and regime stability are distinct stability types.
c_eff is moderately stable across the tested regime sweep.
G_eff is moderately stable across the tested regime sweep.
conditionalClaims: Regime grid is limited to tested ranges.
Results depend on current proxy definitions.
Results depend on current pipeline implementation.
Results do not establish physical validity.
xi sensitivity is measured, not yet theoretically derived.
MeanDist regime robustness is tested only within the frozen grid.
hypotheses: Omega may encode synchronization-frequency response to xi.
MeanDist may encode global geometry robust under xi changes.
Seed variability of MeanDist may arise from topology or realization differences.
c_eff may inherit mixed stability from Omega and calibration structure.
G_eff may remain sensitive to geometry-channel definitions under broader regimes.
Broader regime sweeps may reveal transition surfaces.
Future work may distinguish synchronization-control parameters from geometry-control parameters.
